modules.title: Payment matching
modules.nextAction: Parse a verified connector receipt, normalize asset and amount, and join it to the original invoice and event reference.

modules.title: Asynchronous fulfillment
modules.nextAction: Implement a persistent asynchronous export job and merchant status adapter. Track monotonic revisions and readable evidence-backed artifact references.

modules.nextAction: Deduplicate buyer cases, authorize same-buyer redelivery and implement short-lived grants to the original immutable artifact; record completion receipts or acknowledgment. modules.title: Refund decision and settlement
modules.nextAction: Build full-refund eligibility, merchant approval, revocation of unconsumed grants and serialized disposition. Track dispatch and settlement distinctly.

modules.title: Support console and buyer timeline
modules.nextAction: Build case timeline, evidence-aware status, operator ownership, stale-case filters and buyer refresh. Include distinct proposed, authorized, pending and settled refund badges.

modules.title: Connector reconciliation and field trial
modules.nextAction: Replay omitted, duplicated, reordered and late merchant events through connector endpoints. Add metrics for unique resolved orders, second charges, time to retrieval and false closures.
